title: Integer-shift compatibility of the abelian derived transition
statement: Let $S,Y,Y\prime$ be schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $a:Y\prime\to Y$, $h:Y\to S$, $h\prime:Y\prime\to S$, and $w:a\gg h=h\prime$. Let $K\in D^+(Y_{\mathrm{Et}},\mathrm{Ab})$ and $K\prime\in D^+(Y\prime_{\mathrm{Et}},\mathrm{Ab})$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] and let $t:D^+(a^{-1})K\to K\prime$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image]. Define $T_t:Rh_*K\to Rh\prime_*K\prime$ as the derived unit for $h\prime$, followed by $Rh\prime_*$ of the derived inverse-image composition comparison, $D^+(a^{-1})$ of the derived counit for $h$, and $t$ [prop-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image-adjunction], [def-sbc-abelian-higher-direct-image-map]. For every $n\in\mathbf Z$, let $t_n$ be the shift comparison for $D^+(a^{-1})$ followed by $t[n]$. Then $T_{t_n}\gg c_{Rh\prime_*,n}(K\prime)=c_{Rh_*,n}(K)\gg T_t[n]$, where $c_{R f_*,n}:Rf_*(K[n])\cong(Rf_*K)[n]$ are the specified shift comparisons. This is an equality of derived morphisms for arbitrary complexes; it contains neither homology, raw classes, nor evaluation at a section.

source.place: Tag 09Z1 canonical comparison, explicit derived-adjunction coherence elaboration; exact pullback comparison definitions and derivedPlus unit/counit factorization.

proof.text: Transport along w to hprime = a followed by h. Apply lem-weil-pbc-derived-adjunction-commshift for h and hprime: it supplies compatibility of the specified derived unit and counit with every integer shift. For the exact pullback composition comparison, descend the termwise comparison through the shift-compatible localization factorization; its component in each degree is the underived inverse-image composition comparison, so its shifted component is the same.

Expand T as unit, image of composition comparison, image of counit, and t. Apply these shift identities and naturality of the shift comparisons, cancelling the internal inverse pairs. The surviving end factors are precisely the shifts of Rh_* and Rhprime_*.

theorem abelianDerivedDirectImageTransition_shift {S Y Y' : Scheme.{v}}
    (a : Y' ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ S) (h' : Y' ⟶ S) (w : a ≫ h = h')
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}))
    (K' : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf Y'.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}))
    (t : D+((a)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj K ⟶ K') (n : ℤ) :
    abelianDerivedDirectImageTransition a h h' w (K⟦n⟧) (K'⟦n⟧)
        ((D+((a)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).commShiftIso n).hom.app K ≫
          (shiftFunctor _ n).map t) ≫
        (R+((h')_*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).commShiftIso n).hom.app K' =
      (R+((h)_*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).commShiftIso n).hom.app K ≫
        (shiftFunctor _ n).map (abelianDerivedDirectImageTransition a h h' w K K' t)
